subject: integration
name: Orivon new tab
summary: Orivon's own new tab: one bundled page with a search box, the Featured tiles, bookmarks and the widgets the person added. Its policy allows no network request (connect-src none) and images only from its own bundle, data URLs or the picture the person chose; it talks only to the browser's bridge, which answers this page alone. A search, tile or bookmark is the person's own navigation. Widgets are other sites the person added, judged on their own. Level 4 with privacy: it runs only pinned code and makes no connection of its own. Judged here by its publisher.
